City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
September 12, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

RECOGNITION OF SOLID STATE DEVICES, INC. - It is recommended the City Council present owner Arnold Applebaum with a Certificate of Recognition and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.

PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL PREPAREDNESS MONTH â€“ It is recommended the City Council proclaim September 2017 as National Preparedness Month and present a proclamation to Senior Administrative Analyst Mark Rounds.
6.2 Proclamation for National Preparedness Month

RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Danny Reddig for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
6.3 Recognition of City Employee

La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.

7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of August 22, 2017.
7.1 Minutes
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated September 12, 2017 in the total amount of $3,790,728.02.
7.2 Warrant Register

7.5
SOUTHEAST AREA SOCIAL SERVICES FUNDING AUTHORITY (SASSFA) FUNDING REQUEST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-2018 AND 2018-2019 - It is recommended the City Council approve SASSFAâ€™s funding requests for $30,000 each for Fiscal Year 2017-18 and 2018-19, which includes in-kind contributions per year of $73,692, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.5 SASSFA Funding Request
7.6
GRAYVILLE LIMITED PARTNERSHIP TRANSFER OF LIMITED PARTNER INTEREST AND ADMISTRATIVE GENERAL PARTNER INTEREST - It is recommended the City Council approve the Grayville Limited Partnership transfer of the limited partner interest and the co-general partner interest, and authorize the City Manager to execute the transfer documents on behalf of the City.
7.6 Grayville Limited Partnership Transfer of Interest
7.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-20, ROSECRANS AVENUE DUAL LEFT-TURN POCKETS AT BEACH BOULEVARD â€“ ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by California Landscape and Design Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
7.7 CIP No. 2015-20
7.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-04, STREET NAME SIGN REPLACEMENT PROGRAM AND REGULATORY AND WARNING SIGN INVENTORY AND REPLACEMENT PROGRAM - APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL/TECHNICAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CNC ENGINEERING - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the On-Call Professional/Technical Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and CNC Engineering to provide civil engineering services for the Street Name Sign Replacement Program and an inventory and development of replacement plans for all regulatory and warning signs, based on the proposal from CNC Engineering dated July 28, 2017 for a not to exceed fee of $103,198 and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services to CNC Engineering, if required, for up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount.
7.8 CIP No. 2017-04
7.9
A REPORT OF THE CITY COUNCIL DESCRIBING THE MEASURES TAKEN TO ALLEVIATE THE CONDITIONS WHICH LED TO THE ADOPTION OF AN INTERIM ORDINANCE PROHIBITING NEW ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS EXCEPT THOSE THAT SATISFY SPECIFIC STANDARDS - It is recommended the City Council approve and issue the written report as required by California Government Code Section 65858(d).
7.9 Report Regarding Accessory Dwelling Units

CERTIFICATE OF COMPATIBILITY NO. 59 AND ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENT NO. 42 - A REQUEST TO DEVELOP A TWO-STORY, SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE WITH ATTACHED GARAGE - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law; affirm the CEQA Exemption; and adopt Resolution No. 17-27 thereby approving Certificate of Compatibility No. 59 and Administrative Adjustment No. 42 to develop a two-story, single-family residence with attached three car garage on a vacant parcel located on 13020 Ocaso Avenue, within the Single-family Residential (R-1-15,000) Zoning District and identified as Assessorâ€™s Parcel Number (APN) 8038-035-035.
8.1 CofC No. 59 and AA No. 42
8.1 Attachment - Plans

9.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 696 ESTABLISHING PARKING RESTRICTIONS APPLICABLE TO NONCONFORMING VEHICLES INCLUDING RECREATIONAL VEHICLES, VEHICLES TOWING TRAILERS, AND OTHER VEHICLES EXCEEDING CERTAIN DIMENSIONS, AND AMENDING TITLE 10 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council introduce for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 696 establishing parking restrictions applicable to nonconforming vehicles including recreational vehicles, vehicles towing trailers, and other vehicles exceeding certain dimensions and amending Title 10 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ordinance No. 696
9.1 Attachment - Survey
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 17-28 ESTABLISHING A PARKING FINE FOR NONCONFORMING VEHICLES PARKED ON CITY STREETS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-28 establishing a parking fine for nonconforming vehicles parked on City streets.
9.2 Resolution No. 17-28

FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 698 ESTABLISHING REGULATIONS FOR MAINTAINING AND REGISTERING VACANT OR ABANDONED COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES AND STOREFRONTS AND AMENDING TITLE 9 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 698 establishing regulations for maintaining and registering vacant or abandoned commercial properties and storefronts and amending Title 9 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.3 Ordinance No. 698
